title: Item:Mysterious Remnant Tome
wikitext:
{{TomeTOC}} [[Image:Mysterious Remnant icon.png]] '''Mysterious Remnant Tome''', introduced in [[Update 27]], permanently grants an [[inherent bonus]] to a "stat" in the form of a free feat. +1 and +2 upgrade tomes are acquired by trading in {{Item|Mysterious Remnant}}s to the [[Monster Hunter]] on the second floor of the [[Hall of Heroes]]. +3 upgrade and +4 upgrade tomes are available by '''double-clicking the [[Threads of Fate]]''' in your inventory. +2 , +3 , +4 are only available as upgrade tomes and requires the previous +1 (for +1 to +2 upgrade) or +2 (for +2 to +3), etc. [[File:+1 Tome of Physical Resistance.png|thumb|right|460px|+1 Tome of Physical Resistance]] [[File:+2 Upgrade Tome of Physical Resistance.png|thumb|right|460px|+2 Upgrade Tome of Physical Resistance]] * All tomes are {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}. * Tome provided a [[Inherent bonus]] type and do not stack with other [[inherent bonus]] types. * Bonuses from tomes persist through [[Reincarnation]]. * You can check your Feats on your [[Character Sheet]] to see what [[Inherent bonus]]es you have. == Tomes and Cost == {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center ; {{BgColorVar|set_lightblue}};" |- ! rowspan="2" class="bg-color-1" style="background:#AACCFF;"| Tome of ! rowspan="2" class="bg-color-1" style="background:#AACCFF;"| Bonus
